abstract: In prior notices, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) modified the actions in the Section 301 investigation of China's acts, policies, and practices related to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation by excluding from additional duties certain products of China. While most exclusions have expired in prior years, certain exclusions remain in force. This notice announces the Trade Representative's determination to further extend all 178 current exclusions.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: The modifications announced in the annexes to this notice further extend the exclusions through 11:59 p.m. eastern time on January 9, 2027.
title: Notice of Product Exclusion Extensions: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation
